papers.title: Decoupling Li + Transport in Self‐Healing Polymer Dual‐Salt Electrolytes for Room Temperature Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Gel polymer electrolytes (GPEs) stand as leading candidates for advancing high‐energy‐density lithium metal batteries toward next‐generation applications. However, the inherent crystallinity of conventional polymer matrices severely limits ionic conductivity (IC) and Li + transference number (t Li + ), while imposing large interfacial resistance and uncontrollable lithium dendrite growth—critical bottlenecks hindering practical room‐temperature application. Herein, we report a dual‐salt incorporation strategy within a self‐curing polymer framework to overcome these challenges. The anion‐anion interactions of the dual‐salt system within the polymer network immobilize the anions, thereby liberating a greater number Li + ions. Additionally, the salt‐polymer interactions alter the polymer energy levels, cooperatively enhancing the IC to 2.23 mS cm −1 and the t Li + to 0.55. The electrolyte sustains stable Li||Li symmetric cycling for over 2000 h. When integrated with a LiFePO 4 cathode, the full cell delivers 133 mAh g 1 at 1C with 75% capacity retention over 700 cycles, while the NMC811||Li cell achieves 135 mAh g −1 , retaining 72% of its initial capacity over 250 cycles. Additionally, the electrolyte exhibits inherent flame retardancy and uniform Li + plating‐stripping, effectively suppressing dendrite penetration. This design strategy provides a viable route to ambient‐temperature, self‐curing GPEs that enhance battery safety and suppress dead lithium.
papers.summary_ko: 자가치유 이중염 겔 고분자 전해질을 통해 상온 리튬 금속 전지의 이온전도도(2.23 mS cm⁻¹)와 Li+ 이동률(0.55)을 동시에 향상시켰다. 음이온-음이온 상호작용으로 음이온을 고정해 더 많은 Li+ 이동을 유도하며, Li||Li 대칭 셀에서 2000시간 이상 안정적 사이클링과 덴드라이트 억제 효과를 보였다. LiFePO4 및 NMC811 전극과의 완전셀 테스트에서도 양호한 용량 유지율을 확인했으며, 전해질 자체의 난연성도 구현했다.

papers.title: An untethered sub-gram flapping-wing flight system achieves sustained self-stabilizing and altitude-controlled flight
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Insect-scale flapping-wing micro aerial vehicles offer substantial potential for applications such as search and rescue. However, stringent power and payload constraints at the sub-gram scale have precluded sustained untethered flight. Inspired by the high lift generated by full-circumferential rotor motion, this study presents a cross-shaped piezoelectric direct-drive V-wing structure. The structure uses a tuning-fork vibration mode to generate full-circumferential flapping, suppressing fuselage vibration without external anchoring and substantially improving the lift performance of the piezoelectric direct-drive flapping-wing micro aerial vehicle. Based on this principle, we developed a cross-shaped four-piezoelectric-actuator V-wing micro aerial vehicle weighing 389 mg with a wingspan of 6.8 cm, capable of generating a maximum lift of 1850 mg. Waveform modulation increases the efficiency of the 173 mg drive circuit to 45%, while mechanical self-stabilization suppresses attitude disturbances. Integrated with a 350 mg battery, the 984 mg system achieves untethered, sustained, stable flight for a sub-gram flapping-wing micro aerial vehicle. The maximum lift-to-weight ratio of the untethered flapping-wing micro aerial vehicle system is 1.88. Its maximum flight altitude exceeds 10 m, and its continuous flight duration under low-power operation exceeds 240 s. The system also demonstrates altitude-controlled and disturbance-resilient untethered flight.
papers.summary_ko: 서브그램급 날개짓 비행체를 위한 압전 직접구동 십자형 V자 날개 구조를 개발해 외부 고정 없이도 자세 안정화와 고도 제어가 가능한 무선 비행을 구현했다. 389mg 무게의 비행체가 최대 1850mg의 양력을 내며, 350mg 배터리를 탑재한 984mg 완성 시스템이 지속적인 무선 비행에 성공했다. 최대 고도 10m 이상, 저전력 운용 시 240초 이상의 비행 지속시간을 달성했다.
